attchmntText: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited approved un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Consolidated net loss after tax was 66.73 Crores for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated net loss after tax was 124.61 Crores for the six months ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated total income from operations was 507.37 Crores for the quarter. Consolidated total income from operations was 1,185.01 Crores for the six months. Basic earnings per share was negative 4.26 for the quarter. Basic earnings per share was negative 7.95 for the six months. Statutory auditors T R Chadha & Co. LLP issued a limited review report. The company also submitted a certificate on security cover for non-convertible debentures.
